ItemID: 1; Title: Wirefy Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Wire Shrink Wrap Tube - Waterproof Industrial, Automotive & Boat Tubes - Clear - 275 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to insulate and seal connections made with my spade terminals; the adhesive lining looks useful for repair work.
ItemID: 2; Title: 3" Swivel Caster Wheels with Safety Dual Locking and Polyurethane Foam No Noise Wheels, Heavy Duty - 250 Lbs Per Caster (Pack of 4); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My handtruck purchase suggests occasional moving needs, but I have no current project requiring separate casters.
ItemID: 3; Title: MED PRIDE Medpride Medical Vinyl Examination Gloves (X-Large, 100-Count) Latex Free Rubber | Disposable, Ultra-Strong, Clear | Fluid, Blood, Exam, Healthcare, Food Handling Use | No Powder; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need disposable examination gloves, and I cannot tell whether this size would fit.
ItemID: 4; Title: 560PCS Heat Shrink Tubing 2:1, Eventronic Electrical Wire Cable Wrap Assortment Electric Insulation Heat Shrink Tube Kit with Box(5 colors/12 Sizes); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: This fits my electrical repair interests, but I would choose the adhesive-lined tubing this time rather than buy two assortments.
ItemID: 5; Title: Comfy Package [200 Sets - 5.5 oz.] Plastic Disposable Portion Cups with Lids, Souffle Cups, Jello Cups; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I bought portion cups before, but I have no immediate need for another large pack or a larger size.
ItemID: 6; Title: 260PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors-haisstronica Waterproof Wire Connectors-Heat Shrink Wire Connectors-Self Solder for Marine,Stereo(20Yellow 60White 90Red 90Blue) Solder Sleeve; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for sealed permanent wire repairs, complementing the quick-disconnect terminals I previously bought.
ItemID: 7; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy practical repair hardware, but I have no identified need for fifty washers in this specific size.
ItemID: 8; Title: Zep Neutral PH Industrial Floor Cleaner - 1 Gallon - ZUNEUT128 - Concentrated Pro Trusted All-Purpose Floor Cleaner; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases do not indicate a current floor-cleaning need that would justify a gallon of concentrate.
ItemID: 9; Title: Gorilla Super Glue Gel, 20 Gram, Clear, (Pack of 10); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Adhesives interest me, but super glue serves different repairs from vinyl cement and duct tape, and ten tubes exceed my current needs.
ItemID: 10; Title: Rocaris 80Pcs 1" (25mm) Abrasive Wheel Buffing Polishing Wheel Set for Rotary Tool…; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current polishing task or confirmed compatible rotary tool, so I would skip this set.
